support_verdict.scope: historical observational reweighting bar only; no causal upper bound, efficacy support, class closure or qualification claim

sampling.contact_time: last physics solve at post-step data.time minus physics_dt_s
sampling.plan_time: gait phase used to command the completed control interval
sampling.velocity_scope: legacy body velocity helpers preserved for parity; not endpoint course integration

parity.scope: body medians + scored tick count vs the stance-arm baseline (summary parity, not trajectory parity)

events.matching_definition: chronological one-to-one, abs time difference < half period; unmatched events explicit
events.observation_definition: last-solve touch threshold edges sampled at control rate; not endpoint contact or measured joint lag

support_states.population_definition: pureA/B legacy labels: >=2 loaded feet of one tripod, <=1 of other; includes two-foot support
support_states.reweighting_scope: observed majority-tripod population mean; association only, not a causal upper bound
